inputs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production UI sprite for a fresh, cute, cozy animal rescue mobile game. Use image 1 for canvas and shape placement ONLY; image 2 is the actual game watercolor yard for style and palette reference ONLY. Do not draw any scenery. Fresh storybook watercolor illustration, soft rounded friendly forms, pastel mint and cream with peach accents, clean luminous colors, very subtle brush texture. No aging, no sepia, no bronze, no heavy dark outlines, no sharp corners, no plastic shine, no embossed bevels, no 3D rendering, no realistic shadows. PURE WHITE #ffffff background outside the object with a clean silhouette suitable for alpha extraction. No text or letters or numbers or logos or watermark. Render ONE blank off-white rounded-square dialog card, centrally occupying 88% of canvas. Large soft rounded corners, a delicate pastel mint watercolor rim and a very fine warm gray-green contour, bright milky white interior. A tiny simple two-leaf sprout in each of the upper-left and lower-right corners only, contained fully within the corner area. Keep all central 75% completely blank and uniform for independently rendered text. Flat front view, identical rounded corner radius, no border ornaments running along edges. Friendly and airy but solid, no torn edge.
inputs.negative_prompt: text, typography, letters, numbers, watermark, photorealistic, 3d render, glossy bevel, aged parchment, yellowed paper, distressed grain, brown outlines, dark olive, mustard, hard corners, metallic, heavy drop shadow, scenery, screenshot, extra objects
